{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
# First, confirm all revenue values contain commas or are clean
print("Revenue values with commas:", df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False).sum())

# Now clean: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA rows:", len(qa_rows))

# Check if there are exactly 6 QA rows
assert len(qa_rows) == 6, "Expected exactly 6 QA rows"

# Display first few QA rows to confirm
qa_rows.head()"}
